Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clients

package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clients
Web adapter of registered client management: the administration endpoints, their DTOs, the startup seeding and the optional dynamic client registration.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web
    Web adapter of the authorization server: security filter chains, login page and OpenAPI description.
  • Class
    Description
    ClientAdminController
    Administration of the registered clients, as the contract apis/auth-server/rest-server/auth-server-api-v1.yaml describes it through the generated ClientsApi.
    ClientDtoMapper
    Maps between the DTOs generated from the contract and the client registrations of the domain, so a domain model is never returned from ClientAdminController.
    ClientExceptionHandler
    Translates the failures of ClientAdminController to RFC 9457 problem details, answered as application/problem+json.
    ClientJwksParser
    Parses and validates the public JWK set a client registers for private_key_jwt and self-signed mutual TLS authentication, and converts it between the JSON object of the contract and the JSON text the domain keeps.
    ClientSeeder
    Seeds the configured default clients at startup.
    ClientSeedProperties
    Configuration of the seeding of the default clients (authserver.clients.*).
    ClientSeedProperties.SeededClient
    Seeding of one default client.
    DynamicClientRegistrationConfiguration
    Enables the OpenID Connect dynamic client registration endpoint (/connect/register) when authserver.oidc.client-registration.enabled=true.
    InvalidClientJwksException
    Raised when the public JWK set of a client is not a valid JWK set, is empty or holds a key with private material.
